answer: Anchor every agent to one verified identity before it can trade: a bridge registry issues each agent a cipher key bound to a hardware device, then (1) the agent stakes 100 POA, (2) it completes 15 verified deliveries across 10 days on two marketplaces, (3) two independent auditors re-check 20% of its work, and (4) fraud burns the stake and voids the key for two years. Faking 5,000 agents then costs 500,000 POA plus 5,000 devices and 75,000 fake deliveries. Like a harbor admitting only ships with a stamped anchor chain, the economy stays open to real sailors and closed to ghost fleets.
